# Fortune Studios

> Three photo and video studios for hire, with white and black cycloramas, lights included, between OMR and Velachery.

Website: https://fortunestudios.in/
Phone / WhatsApp: +91 98403 58636

## Contact
- Fortune Studios (Studio 1 & 2) · 7, Ground Floor, Vallalar Street, VGP Shanti Nagar, Pallikaranai, Chennai 600 100 · +91 98403 58636 (call or WhatsApp) · Mon–Sat 9 AM–5 PM · info@fortunestudios.in
- Fortune Studios 2.0 · 1, Kovalan Nagar, 1st Main Rd, Pallikaranai, Chennai 600 100 · Near Pallikaranai Corporation Office, behind KFC · +91 98403 58636

## Key facts
- started in Vadapalani 2004
- 2,500 sq ft of shooting floor
- 3 studios across two locations
- 15 people on set in Studio 1, cast included

## Facilities
- White cyclorama (24.5 × 18 ft)
- Black cyclorama (20 × 16 ft)
- Studio flash heads included
- Removable sound panels
- A/C green room
- Bathroom with shower
- Large access doors
- Sheltered set-building space
- Product tables
- Interchangeable backgrounds
- Ample parking
- 2, 4 and 8-hour sessions
- Extend by the hour

## Frequently asked questions

### Where is Fortune Studios?
7, Ground Floor, Vallalar Street, VGP Shanti Nagar, Pallikaranai, Chennai 600 100.

### What facilities does Fortune Studios have?
White cyclorama (24.5 × 18 ft), Black cyclorama (20 × 16 ft), Studio flash heads included, Removable sound panels, A/C green room, Bathroom with shower, Large access doors, Sheltered set-building space, Product tables, Interchangeable backgrounds, Ample parking, 2, 4 and 8-hour sessions, Extend by the hour.

### How long can I book for?
2, 4 or 8-hour sessions, and you can extend in 1-hour steps. Fortune Studios 2.0 suits shorter 1 to 4-hour shoots.

### Are lights included?
Yes. The Studio 1 fee includes professional studio flash heads, and Studio 2 has professional lighting for product and portrait work.

### How do I book Fortune Studios?
Pick a date in the booking section of this page and send it on WhatsApp, or call +91 98403 58636.
